updateAvailable: An update is available for Sunshine Broadcast Tools. Do you want to update?
updateFailed: The update didn't work. The stream will start with the current version.
ready:
Stream is running.

On the viewing device, open Moonlight, select "{host}" and then "{app}".
sunshineMissing: Sunshine is not installed on this computer.
startFailed:

Check that the Sunshine service is installed and that users are allowed to start it.

End the stream?

stoppingLidClosed: Stopping stream because the laptop was put to sleep...
sleepEnded: Sunshine stream ended because you put the laptop to sleep.

applied: Sunshine has been configured and the Start & End shortcuts were added to the desktop.
restarted: Sunshine was restarted to apply the changes.
adminRequired: Administrator permission is required to configure Sunshine.
componentsNeeded: Broadcast needs extra components (VB-CABLE, svcl, libmpv). Install them now?
componentsFailed:
Could not install the broadcast components.

{error}
componentsRestart: VB-CABLE installed. Restart the computer, then open Setup again.
hostAudioOff:
{device} tried to connect, we REFUSED it because it isn’t set up properly for broadcast.
In Moonlight app on {device}, UNTICK “Mute host PC speakers” (for PC) or turn ON “Play audio on PC” (for Android/Google TV), then close Moonlight fully and connect again.
markedWorking: Saved this version as the last working version. You can go back to it from Setup.
runnerFallback: Note: run-hidden.exe doesn't work on this laptop, so streams use the old hidden method instead. Streaming still works, but devices that aren't set up properly for broadcast get a warning instead of being refused. The reason is in debug.log.
